environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to BLOCK at sensitivity_level HIGH, (2) a custom rule with RegexPatternSet matching field 'SingleQueryArgument:warehouse' against pattern '^[a-z]{2,20}$' with action BLOCK on NO_MATCH (i.e., requests where the warehouse parameter does not match the regex are blocked), (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in COUNT mode only (not blocking). The ALB target group health check path is /api/v1/products/1. CloudWatch logging enabled for WAFv2 sampled requests.

config.runtime: Python 3.11, Flask 3.0, gunicorn on ECS Fargate
